areas.narrativeSummary: The school describes a broad and challenging curriculum intended to help children become deep thinkers, resilient learners and compassionate, responsible citizens [1]. History is presented as high quality and carefully structured, with planned trips including Windsor Castle in Year 2, Butser Farm in Year 3 and Haslemere Museum in Year 4 [2]. Its pupil premium strategy also notes a focus on improving combined reading, writing and maths scores for pupil premium pupils [3].
